response_text:
Claim 1 (Currently amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, __a compound of formula I:__

__[Chemical structure showing formula I with specific R-group definitions as defined in original claim 6]__

__wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof; and (B) __a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist__ selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, __a compound of formula I as defined in claim 1,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, __a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist__ selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, __a compound of formula I as defined in claim 1,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including __a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist__ selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable salt thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

Claim 6 (Cancelled)

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1, wherein R1 and R2 either both represent H or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 or Claim 7, wherein R3 represents phenyl (optionally substituted by one to three substituents selected from halo, C1-3 alkyl and C1-3 alkoxy) or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or two substituents selected from OR7 and oxo.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1, 7 to 8, wherein R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1, 7 to 9, wherein R4 and R5 both represent H.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1, 7 to 10, wherein R6 represents H.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1, 7 to 11, wherein R3 represents -CH3, -CH2OH, -C(O)C(O)CH3, -C(O)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OC(O)CH3)CH(OC(O)CH3)CH3 or unsubstituted phenyl.

Claim 13 (Cancelled)

Claim 14 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1, wherein __the renin inhibitor, ACE inhibitor or AT1 receptor antagonist__ is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein __the renin inhibitor, ACE inhibitor or AT1 receptor antagonist__ is a compound selected from the group consisting of eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan or candesartan __cilexetil__.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5, __7 to 12, 14 to 15__, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5, __7 to 12, 14 to 15__, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5, __7 to 12, 14 to 15__, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5, __7 to 12, 14 to 15__; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.
